_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Dhan Vriddhi Credit Card (RuPay Platinum)
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: Issuer card page: "Redemption of reward points @ Rs.0.05/point" (also Credit Card Policy v6.0: cashback at INR 0.05 per point). Redemption fee nil for cash redemption, INR 75 for gifts (MITC).

action.reason: No reward points on cash withdrawals, EMI conversions or cashback transactions (Credit Card Policy v6.0, loyalty programme); a retail transaction converted to EMI earns no points (Terms and Conditions 11.9). MCC lists are not stated.
5% cashback on grocery spends, maximum INR 50 per billing cycle (card page; Policy v6.0). The Namaste page words it "supermarkets and departmental stores, maximum INR 50 a month".
2 reward points per INR 100 spent (card page; Policy v6.0). Redeemed at INR 0.05 per point.

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Annual fee INR 400 + GST waived on annual usage of INR 50,000 (MITC footnote and card page); the page does not say card anniversary year or calendar year.

welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: 1,000 points for spends above INR 10,000 within 90 days of issuance (card page). Rupee value is 1,000 x INR 0.05 = INR 50 at the stated redemption rate.

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: Issuer card page for Dhan Vriddhi Credit Card (RuPay Platinum) (benefits, annual fee, lounge, reward line)
Most Important Terms and Conditions (2 pages; one fee table for Visa/RuPay Platinum and RuPay Select; the EMI illustration is dated Dec 2023 to Jun 2024)
Credit Card Policy Version 6.0 (18 pages, PDF created 9 Jan 2026): product lines, reward programme, schedule of charges
Credit Card Terms & Conditions (12 pages, undated): general terms; EMI transactions earn no reward points (clause 11.9)

open_questions: Fuel transaction surcharge: the MITC table says "10 or 2.5%" and the Credit Card Policy v6.0 (Jan 2026) says "Rs.10 or 1.0% of transaction amount whichever is high". The two conflict; the newer Policy value (1.0%) is stored; no fuel surcharge waiver is stated for these cards.

Late payment fee is 30% of the Minimum Amount Due with a minimum of INR 400 and a maximum of INR 600 (MITC and Policy); it cannot be shown as fixed slabs, so late_payment_slabs is empty and the rule is stored in additional_data.
Joining fee is nil for new customers but INR 400 for customers who earlier took and closed a Dhanlaxmi credit card within the last three years (MITC footnote); stored joining_fee_inr is 0.

Annual fee INR 400 + GST (Platinum) / INR 800 + GST (Select); waived on annual usage of INR 50,000 (Platinum) / INR 1,00,000 (Select); add-on usage counts (MITC footnote). Policy says renewal fee nil and the annual fee is applicable for activated cards closed within 12 months.

Interest: 1.90% a month (22.80% a year) on revolving credit, 36% a year on cash advances, 3.5% a month (42% a year) from the date of default (MITC, Policy). The Policy says the rate is benchmarked to the 1-year MCLR with spread capped at 32%.
Interest free credit period 20 to 50 days on retail purchases if the previous balance is paid in full.

Cash advance fee INR 400 per transaction; cash limit 15% of the total credit limit; overlimit 2.5% of the amount over the limit (min INR 300); cheque return / auto-debit dishonour INR 500; EMI processing fee 1% of the converted amount, foreclosure 2% of outstanding EMIs; reward redemption fee INR 75 for gifts and nil for cash (MITC).

Reward expiry: the Credit Card Policy says "Point Expiry: Every 2 years (on 20th September)" in its general loyalty section; it is not tied to a card variant, so 24 months is used only for the variants whose pages list the same programme.
The INR 50 cap is on the cashback amount (not on spend), stored as limit_value_inr 50 under a bonus-reward metric.
Reward-points exclusions beyond cash withdrawals, EMI conversions and cashback transactions: no MCC list is published in the documents read.

Lounge access: the page lists the quota; the "Lounge Access" link on the page opens no separate document in the HTML read, so the lounge programme, eligibility spend and per-visit rules are not stated.
Credit Card on UPI is listed as a feature; the setup is not described.

The page footnote marks reward points with "#" (conditions not shown in the page text) and the benefits with "T & C Apply"; the "Terms and Conditions of platinum Credit Card Offers" (cc-offer-tc.pdf) is only a generic offer disclaimer with no terms for these benefits.
Bonus reward: the Credit Card Policy v6.0 lists 4,000 points on annual spends of INR 3,00,000 or more; the card page does not list it, so it is not modelled.
Network tier: the page title says RuPay platinum; no other tier information.

value.rule: 30% of the Minimum Amount Due, minimum INR 400, maximum INR 600
value.source: MITC and Credit Card Policy v6.0
